name: modrixcommerce/currency-converter
description: Keeps storefront exchange rates up to date. When a shopper switches currency, prices convert from the store currency automatically. Checkout and payments stay in the store currency.
author: Modrix team

settings.label: Currencies shoppers can choose
settings.help: Comma-separated codes, such as AED, EUR, GBP. Rates are units of that currency for 1 unit of the store currency.

settings.label: Refresh rates every (hours)
settings.help: How long a fetched rate is reused before the next lookup. A failed lookup keeps the last good rate.
